cc:Work.dc:title: Main: observed token usage per stored run
cc:Work.dc:description: Canonical saved aggregates; 40 sample clusters x 2 repeats per strategy/cell. Bars: saved 95% sample-cluster bootstrap CI; no multiplicity adjustment. 1K Proposed stops before model execution. Overlapping curves retain distinct markers. Input is the per-run maximum counted context, not cumulative provider usage. Proposed 1K input is unmeasured after preflight stop. H100/2K output-token means use 78 Sliding and 79 Utility runs. Sources: docs/results/main_20261109/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/main-final-analysis-2026-11-09.md

g.text: Main: observed token usage per stored run

main_06_tokens | Canonical saved aggregates; 40 sample clusters x 2 repeats per strategy/cell. Bars: saved 95% sample-cluster bootstrap CI; no multiplicity adjustment. 1K Proposed stops before model execution.

Overlapping curves retain distinct markers. Input is the per-run maximum counted context, not cumulative provider usage. Proposed 1K input is unmeasured after preflight stop. H100/2K output-token means use 78 Sliding
